shanghai_2019.limitation: Eligible existing/resolved-tariff projects and five named exceptions; staged adjustment; not all gas capacity

shanghai_2024.capacity_basis: Approved capacity outside summer/winter; declared maximum output within licence in peak months
shanghai_2024.limitation: Own-cause zero-generation months generally receive zero except planned maintenance/normal standby; grid/gas/force-majeure exemptions; provisional payment then true-up

guangdong_2023.repeated_full_deduction_rule: Three fully deducted months in a natural year cancels eligibility
guangdong_2023.funding: All provincial industrial/commercial users, proportional to monthly consumption, system operating expense
guangdong_2023.limitation: Compliant in-service public plants only; excludes self-supply/noncompliant plants; actual declarations, deductions and receipts unobserved

nea_capacity_fee_inclusion.definition: average feed-in tariff = electricity sales revenue / exported electricity * 1.17
nea_capacity_fee_inclusion.modelling_decision: Do not add capacity revenue on top of NEA income-equivalent mean tariff absent reconciled decomposition
nea_capacity_fee_inclusion.additional_limit: 2018 lacks this formula footnote; 2013-2015 saved HTML is abridged and lacks complete annex definitions
